caption: The drawing is an overhead, plan-view illustration of a garden with symmetric composition and separated areas. There are two large, gray-roofed rectangular buildings in the lower half, with the larger one on the left and the smaller on the right. Both sit on green lawns bordered by pathways in a beige-pink color. In the upper-left quadrant, there are two flowerbeds: one is rectangular with geometric sections colored purple, yellow, red, green, and white, and the second contains an oval shape surrounded by blue, white, and red flowers. In the top right quadrant, a beige octagonal path frames a standing human statue with green clothing, standing on a pedestal, set on green grass. Scattered trees with round yellow-green foliage are placed along the paths and lawns. A curved flower bed, mostly colored with blue, pink, and yellow, is in the lower right. At the very bottom, a black fence with decorative ironwork runs horizontally, marking the garden boundary. There are smaller gray rectangular structures in the upper part of the image and benches or base objects located around the major paths. The image is bordered by a beige margin.
title: Ward and Green Gardens
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
